title: Solar-Powered Agro-Processing: Business Model Development Guide
summary: A practical guide to developing viable business models for solar-powered agro-processing enterprises, including financial planning, tariff setting, and enterprise governance.
description: This guide supports programme managers, entrepreneur support organisations, and cooperatives to establish financially viable solar-powered agro-processing enterprises. It covers business model design (cooperative, franchise, private enterprise, public-private partnership), market linkage strategies, financial projection tools, tariff-setting methodologies, and governance structures. Case studies from Uganda and East Africa are included for solar milling enterprises, dairy processing facilities, and coffee processing units. The guide includes worksheet templates for business planning and simple M&E frameworks for tracking enterprise performance. The guide was developed under the GIZ Pro-REP programme in collaboration with NREP.
